rootCauseHypothesis:
The PPTX export control is likely not being clicked successfully because the hosting/UI layer is making that menu item intermittently inaccessible to automation—commonly due to an overlay, animation, z-index/pointer-events issue, or a hidden/disabled state despite appearing enabled. Another possibility is that the PPTX option is wired incorrectly or its handler fails silently, so the visible menu entry exists but does not initiate the download workflow, while the HTML export path works normally. Underlying error: TEST FAILURE

Clicking the PPTX export option could not be verified — repeated automated click attempts timed out and no .pptx download or success toast occurred.

Observations:
- The Export menu lists PowerPoint (PPTX), PDF, Standalone HTML and PNG; the primary export options are visible and enabled.
- The 'Standalone HTML' export succeeded: a notification/toast saying 'Standalone HTML downloaded.' is visible on the page and in the screenshot.
- Repeated attempts to click the 'PPTX (editable)' option timed out (multiple click watchdog timeouts), and no .pptx download or success toast was observed; the PPTX export could not be triggered by the automated test.

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Make the PPTX export item a reliably clickable, non-overlayed control and ensure the export handler is actually wired for the PPTX option. On the hosting/app side, check for any invisible overlay, disabled state, pointer-events issues, or menu auto-close/animation timing that can prevent automated clicks. If the PPTX action opens a new tab or uses async generation, ensure it is not blocked by browser popups/CSP and that a download is triggered with a proper .pptx filename. Verify the menu item text/selector matches what the test targets (e.g. 'PPTX (editable)') and that the click handler does not depend on hover-only behavior or transient layout changes. If generation is server-side, confirm the endpoint returns a valid PPTX response and that the client shows a success toast/download event after completion.
